name: My Agents
author: Omarchy
description: Claude Code, Codex, and Fireworks usage, limits, and pace in a native Omarchy bar panel.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one panel: rate-limit meters with pace, today, the last week, and the all-time model breakdown for every subscription.

schema.label: Grok weekly limit updates
schema.description: Auto opens a throwaway Grok and reads /usage on a timer. Manual only updates when you press the button.

schema.label: Grok auto-check interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often Auto mode scrapes the Grok weekly limit. 900 = 15 minutes.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Snapshot file name
schema.description: Optional. Defaults to <hostname>.json. Use a different file name on each machine, such as laptop.json or desktop.json.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
